description: This file defines the core parsing classes and templates for the Thunder project, including a generic ParserType template class, TextParser, and PathParser, along with associated enums, methods, and data structures used for parsing text, key-value pairs, ranges, and file paths.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing text streams with customizable terminators and handlers, managing parsing states, buffer collection, and pass-through functionality.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text fragments, reading text, numbers, enumerations, key-value pairs, and ranges from a text stream.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing file paths into drive, path, filename, base filename, and extension components.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state to initial conditions.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Returns the current byte position in the stream.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Configures the parser to collect a word, optionally with a split character and case state.

methods.name: CollectLine
methods.description: Configures the parser to collect a line.

methods.name: FlushLine
methods.description: Sets the parser to flush the current line.

methods.name: PassThrough
methods.description: Configures the parser to pass through a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a stream of bytes into the parser, handling pass-through, line flushing, whitespace skipping, and token parsing.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from a fragment until delimiters are encountered.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of specified type from the text stream.

methods.name: ReadEnumerate
methods.description: Reads an enumeration value from the text stream.

methods.name: ReadKeyValuePair
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair from the text stream, separated by a specified divider.

methods.name: ReadRange
methods.description: Reads a range of numbers from the text stream.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a TextFragment into path components.
